items.prompt: Create one original photorealistic cinematic widescreen 16:9 location reference for '火车 / passenger train interior'. Inside an older long-distance train carriage, camera from the aisle looks diagonally through rows of worn blue seats and large windows; one adult passenger reads near a window while another walks toward the far carriage door. Rural landscape softly streaks outside, warm overhead practical lights and cool morning daylight reveal narrow circulation, reflections and seat geometry. Authentic train proportions, quiet travel mood. No legible text, logos, watermark, border, collage, or copied film frame.

items.prompt: One original photorealistic cinematic 16:9 film-location reference for '飞机 / airplane cabin'. Interior of a modern narrow-body passenger aircraft at dawn, viewed diagonally down the aisle from mid-cabin: curved ceiling, overhead bins, seat rows, a few fully dressed adult travelers and a flight attendant in neutral uniform preparing the cabin, golden sun through oval windows above cloud. Show the constrained aisle, seating relationships and practical overhead light for staging. No airline branding, legible signage, logo, watermark, border, collage, or copied movie frame.

items.prompt: Create one original photorealistic cinematic 16:9 film-location still for '船 / boat or ferry'. On the open upper deck of a small passenger ferry crossing a wide estuary at dawn, wet metal railings, coiled ropes, lifeboat, cabin door and a few fully dressed adult travelers in coats; a distant shoreline fades into blue mist. Camera from deck level shows circulation, ship structure and a horizon that conveys motion over water, soft salt-air light and realistic textures. No maritime brand names, readable text, logo, watermark, border, collage, or copied film frame.
